build_dinov2_vitl14: build a DINOv2 ViT-L/14 vision transformer model pretrained on the LVD-142M dataset
build_dinov2_vitg14: build a DINOv2 ViT-g/14 vision transformer model with swiglufused FFN layer pretrained on LVD-142M
build_dinov2_vitl14_reg: build a DINOv2 ViT-L/14 model with 4 register tokens and antialias interpolation enabled
build_dinov2_vits14: build a DINOv2 ViT-S/14 small vision transformer model pretrained on the LVD-142M dataset
build_dinov2_custom: build a custom DINOv2 model with specified architecture, image size, patch size, and pretrained weights
